'''Mitch Velasco''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Bravo 30 from Jacksonville, Fl. The slot was retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).

== 2002 ==

In March 2002 MaryGail Coffee named Velasco as the Jacksonville squadron member who would teach the ''Austin Powers'' CCG at the Conquest convention in Kissimmee, Florida.<ref name="rfd119">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8KvLjZofZcY&t=715s Broadcast 119 - Radio Free Decipher (15 March, 2002): Chris and MaryGail Coffee on SWCCG Open], Player's Council, YouTube (uploaded 13 May 2022), at 11:55. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-8KvLjZofZcY Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Radio Free Decipher/Episode 119 transcript]].</ref> Conquest hosted the first SWCCG Open sanctioned by the [[Players Committee]].<ref name="rfd119" />
